description: Fetch live components, objects and traits (including registered team definitions; business objects, with OODS Foundry's internal objects only when includeInternal is true and registry.hiddenInternal counting the ones left out), or archived tokens/manifest data or a Stage1 run's artifacts via kind+runPath: the rollups (identity_graph, capability_rollup, object_rollup, drift_report) and the run-view kinds at their pinned versions — a11y_report 2.2.0/2.3.0, report_index 1.0.0/1.1.0, a11y_evidence 1.1.0/1.2.0 (every per-page axe file read only when its sha256 matches the run manifest's attestation) and run_manifest (historical unstamped shape or schema_version 1.0.0 through 1.6.0; a suite's root, which records its targets, is refused). Any other version is refused rather than parsed. In dataset mode it computes a canonical payload ETag and honours ifNoneMatch consistently across paths; a mismatched manifest ETag warns and malformed manifest JSON returns OODS-S005, meta.source distinguishes live-registry from committed-export; version pins a dated export (the nearest earlier one, with a warning, when that date has none) and listVersions lists the dated exports; listVersions and version are dataset-only; supplying them in kind mode returns structuredData.fetch-specific OODS-V202. The separate derived_analysis kind admits manifest.analysis provenance/run_manifest/drift_report1.0.0, report_index1.1.0 and fig_local_tokens version1.0.0/1.3.0 after retained-file digest, confined realpath, lineage, identity/time and JSON-pointer checks. A derived analysis is never a captured run; copied inputs are not rerun.

inputSchema.description: Read structured datasets or Stage1 rollups. listVersions and version are dataset-only; kind mode rejects these options with structuredData.fetch-specific OODS-V202.

dataset.description: Local structured dataset to return (components/tokens/manifest). Mutually exclusive with kind+runPath.

ifNoneMatch.description: Return matched=true without payload when the ETag matches.

includeInternal.description: Live components dataset only: also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them; a dated export is served unchanged.

includePayload.description: When false, omit payload even if no ETag match occurs.

kind.description: Stage1 structured artifact kind to read from runPath. Requires runPath; mutually exclusive with dataset. The rollups (identity_graph, capability_rollup, object_rollup, drift_report) and the run-view kinds at their pinned versions: a11y_report 2.2.0/2.3.0, report_index 1.0.0/1.1.0, a11y_evidence (evidence manifest 1.1.0/1.2.0, every per-page axe file read only when its sha256 matches the run manifest's attestation) and run_manifest (historical unstamped shape or schema_version 1.0.0 through 1.6.0; a suite's root, which records its targets, is refused). derived_analysis reads a directory containing manifest.analysis, admitting provenance/run_manifest/drift_report 1.0.0, report_index 1.1.0 and fig_local_tokens version 1.0.0/1.3.0 with retained-file attestation, lineage, realpath and JSON-pointer checks. Any other version is refused.

listVersions.description: When true, return available version dates instead of payload.

runPath.description: Filesystem path to a Stage1 run directory or its artifacts/ subdirectory. Required when kind is set.

version.description: Request a specific date-stamped version (e.g., '2026-02-24'). Omit for latest. Applies to dataset mode only.

name: structuredData_fetch
